leftEvidence.title: Jacob speaks over Joseph’s fruitfulness, conflict, strength, and abundance

points.label: Images of abundance
points.left: Spring, wall, heavens, deep, breast, womb, and hills gather around Joseph.
points.right: Dew, deep, sun, moon, mountains, hills, and earth gather around the land.

points.label: Separation and strength
points.left: Joseph is separated from brothers and sustained against archers.
points.right: Joseph’s firstborn strength pushes peoples through Ephraim and Manasseh.

payload.posture: Hold both complete source units together before drawing a conclusion.

rightEvidence.title: Moses speaks over Joseph’s land, produce, strength, Ephraim, and Manasseh

payload.tension: The second blessing carries Joseph’s name into land and tribes beyond his lifetime.
payload.title: Jacob’s blessing / Moses’ blessing
